samples.summary: Paste-created merges bypass the freeze-pane guard that every other merge-creation path honours, violating the invariant documented at docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:253 and assumed by the renderer
samples.evidence: The only existing merge-creation entry point, `mergeSelection`, refuses a block crossing the freeze boundary via `canMergeSelection` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4591-4599: `crossesFrozenRows`/`crossesFrozenCols`). `docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:253` states "Merges that cross freeze pane boundaries are disallowed." The new `planPasteMerges` (sheet.ts:2390) translates the copied blocks by the paste delta and creates them with no freeze check, so with `frozenCols=2` copying a merged D1:E1 and pasting at B1 yields a B1:C1 block straddling the boundary. The renderer relies on the invariant: `packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1917` `toCellRect` computes the merged rect from a single scrolled origin, so a straddling block is drawn with the wrong rect across the frozen pane (the same hole exists in `moveRangeTo`, which is also unguarded, but this change adds a second reachable path). Fix belongs in `planPasteMerges`/`applyPasteMerges`.

samples.summary: Both view paste paths call `clearCopyBuffer()` unconditionally after `sheet.paste(...)`, so the new `merge-paste-partial` early return silently destroys the pending cut/copy buffer even though nothing was pasted
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:4938 and packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:725 call `this.sheet.clearCopyBuffer(); this.render();` right after `paste(...)`, with no way to learn the model refused (paste returns `void`). After the new refusal at sheet.ts:2260 the user sees the toast, the marching-ants selection is dropped and the internal buffer is gone, so unmerging the destination and re-pressing Ctrl+V now takes the external TSV path (no formula relocation, no merge propagation) instead of retrying the internal paste. Fix belongs either on `paste`'s signature (report the refusal) or on these two call sites.

samples.summary: A pasted merge is not clamped to the sheet dimensions, so a block pasted near the last row/column can extend past `Dimensions`
samples.evidence: `Dimensions = { rows: 1000000, columns: 18278 }` (sheet.ts:148) bounds every selection, so `mergeSelection` can never create a block extending past the grid; `planPasteMerges` (sheet.ts:2413) just adds the delta to the copied anchor and keeps the original span, so pasting a 3-column merged block at column 18277 persists a merge covering columns 18277-18279. `rebuildMergeCoverMap` (sheet.ts:816) and `buildMergeRenderData` (packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1900-1909) then walk refs outside the grid. Low confidence that this is reachable in practice; the backend validator (packages/backend/src/yorkie/worksheet-settings.ts:136) rejects out-of-grid anchors but not out-of-grid spans.

finding.summary: Paste-created merges bypass the freeze-pane guard that every other merge-creation path honours, violating the invariant documented at docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:253 and assumed by the renderer
finding.evidence: The only existing merge-creation entry point, `mergeSelection`, refuses a block crossing the freeze boundary via `canMergeSelection` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4591-4599: `crossesFrozenRows`/`crossesFrozenCols`). `docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:253` states "Merges that cross freeze pane boundaries are disallowed." The renderer relies on the invariant: `packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1917` `toCellRect` computes the merged rect from a single scrolled origin, so a straddling block is drawn with the wrong rect across the frozen pane (the same hole exists in `moveRangeTo`, which is also unguarded, but this change adds a second reachable path). verdict.reason: The finding is real as described. `canMergeSelection` (sheet.ts:4591-4599) rejects selections crossing the freeze boundary and `mergeSelection` gates on it (4618), and docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:253 documents the invariant. `planPasteMerges` (sheet.ts:2390-2439) builds destination merges purely by translating source anchors (2413-2416) and `applyPasteMerges` commits them via `store.setMerge`/`this.merges.set` (2471-2473) with no freeze check; the caller at 2248-2264 only refuses partial-overlap splits, and the delta comes from the user-controlled `activeCell` (2240-2241) via the public `paste()` (2214), so a block straddling `frozenCols`/`frozenRows` is reachable. No other guard exists — `frozenRows`/`frozenCols` are only read at 1344-1366 and 4592-4598. The renderer genuinely assumes the invariant: `toCellRect` (gridcanvas.ts:1917-1940) derives the merged rect from a single scroll origin while frozen quadrants are drawn with distinct scroll offsets (gridcanvas.ts:291-394), so a straddling merge is drawn with a wrong rect. This is in the blast-radius lane (invariant other modules assume, violated at a new entry point) and major.
